When dev is ready for release:
	Switch to main.
	Merge with dev.
	Resolve conflicts.
	Make sure all looks good.
	Otherwise make changes and keep committing to main.
	Diverge dev whenever main is ready and polished.
	
Code formatting:
	Use CodeMaid 2026
	In Extensions -> Enable Automatic Cleanup on Save.
	This will run Ctrl + M, Space.
		Will clean up and format the document.
	Periodically run Ctrl + M, Z.
		This will sort methods and other members based on visibility and data type.
